name: Talaat Moustafa Group Holding
source: CRON 2026-11-12: H1 2026 column added from Talaat Mostafa Group Holding Company TMG Holding S.A.E interim consolidated statement of profit or loss for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (review report issued 12 August 2026), Egyptian pounds in units. Note 32 prints Total Revenue 30,192,000,051 and Total Cost of Revenue 20,450,890,810, leaving the printed Gross profit 9,741,109,241. Operating Profit (EBIT) is the printed Operating Income 12,931,563,736 less the printed Depreciation and amortization 259,752,684 = 12,671,811,052; Operating Income is gross profit plus Gains from revaluation of investment properties 1,591,840,177 and Other income 4,105,451,584 less General and administrative 1,129,832,756, Marketing 512,064,196, Governmental donations and other 403,530,844 and Provisions and expected credit losses 118,514,820. Operating Expenses is left empty because every expense line in this statement is offset by printed income lines within Operating Income, so a single expenses figure cannot be stated without netting income into it. Net Finance Costs is -73,883,665, being the printed Finance income net of 31,104,386 plus the printed Share of profit from associates 42,779,279, stored negative because it is net income, and it is the exact bridge from EBIT to the printed Profit for the period before tax 12,745,694,717. Income tax expense 2,542,697,531 plus deferred tax expense 257,240,709 equals 2,799,938,240, leaving the printed Net profit for the period 9,945,756,477, of which 7,477,433,949 is attributable to the parent and 2,468,322,528 to non-controlling interests; basic earnings per share 3.63. Checks: 30,192,000,051 less 20,450,890,810 equals 9,741,109,241; 12,745,694,717 less 2,799,938,240 equals 9,945,756,477. ROE, ROA and Debt to Equity left empty because this column carries no balance sheet input. | Yahoo Finance | extended from stockanalysis.com | gap-filled 2026-10-07 from stockanalysis.com EGX income statement
